``````python
"""Authoritative 60 Hz arena simulation. No client damage or position is trusted."""
import math
import random
import secrets
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict

from .arenas import ARENAS, DEFAULT_ARENA, MAP, PLAYER_RADIUS
from .hazards import train_pose, train_hits, segment_box
from .weapons import WEAPONS, GRENADE_TYPES, THROW_TYPES
from .roles import ROLES, profile
from .combat import bullet_impact
from .projectiles import world_geometry, advance, safe_floor

CHEATS = ('aim', 'esp', 'recoil', 'ammo')
AIM_CONE = .95
MOVE_SPEED = 8.0
MOVE_ACCEL = 22.0

def angle(a):
    return (a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi

def wall(x, y, grid=MAP):
    return not (0 <= x < len(grid[0]) and 0 <= y < len(grid)) or grid[int(y)][int(x)] == '1'

def clear(x, y, xx, yy, grid=MAP):
    if wall(x,y,grid) or wall(xx,yy,grid): return False
    cx,cy,ex,ey=math.floor(x),math.floor(y),math.floor(xx),math.floor(yy)
    dx,dy=xx-x,yy-y;sx=1 if dx>0 else -1;sy=1 if dy>0 else -1
    tx=abs(1/dx) if dx else math.inf;ty=abs(1/dy) if dy else math.inf
    nx=((cx+1-x) if dx>0 else (x-cx))*tx if dx else math.inf
    ny=((cy+1-y) if dy>0 else (y-cy))*ty if dy else math.inf
    for _ in range(len(grid)+len(grid[0])+2):
        if (cx,cy)==(ex,ey): return True
        if abs(nx-ny)<1e-10:
            if wall(cx+sx+.5,cy+.5,grid) or wall(cx+.5,cy+sy+.5,grid): return False
            cx+=sx;cy+=sy;nx+=tx;ny+=ty
        elif nx<ny:cx+=sx;nx+=tx
        else:cy+=sy;ny+=ty
        if wall(cx+.5,cy+.5,grid): return False
    return False


def move(p, dx, dy, grid=MAP):
    for axis, delta in [('x', dx), ('y', dy)]:
        x, y = p.x, p.y
        if axis == 'x': x += delta
        else: y += delta
        if all(not wall(x+a, y+b,grid) for a in (-PLAYER_RADIUS,PLAYER_RADIUS) for b in (-PLAYER_RADIUS,PLAYER_RADIUS)):
            setattr(p, axis, getattr(p, axis)+delta)

def walk(p, f, s, dt, aiming=False, grid=MAP):
    """Accelerate along a normalized analog input, with friction on release."""
    length = max(1, math.hypot(f, s))
    speed = (5.7 if aiming else MOVE_SPEED)*profile(p.skin)['speed']*(.55 if p.crouch else 1)
    tx = (math.cos(p.yaw)*f-math.sin(p.yaw)*s)*speed/length
    ty = (math.sin(p.yaw)*f+math.cos(p.yaw)*s)*speed/length
    blend = 1-math.exp(-MOVE_ACCEL*dt)
    dx = tx*dt + (p.vx-tx)*blend/MOVE_ACCEL
    dy = ty*dt + (p.vy-ty)*blend/MOVE_ACCEL
    p.vx += (tx-p.vx)*blend
    p.vy += (ty-p.vy)*blend
    ox, oy = p.x, p.y
    # Small collision steps prevent tunnelling when a frame is delayed.
    steps = max(1, math.ceil(max(abs(dx),abs(dy))/.24))
    for _ in range(steps): move(p, dx/steps, dy/steps,grid)
    if abs(p.x-ox) < .00001: p.vx = 0
    if abs(p.y-oy) < .00001: p.vy = 0

@dataclass
class Player:
    id: str
    name: str
    team: int
    bot: bool = False
    skin: str = 'scout'
    x: float = 2.5
    y: float = 2.5
    yaw: float = 0
    pitch: float = 0
    z: float = 0
    vz: float = 0
    crouch: bool = False
    jump_held: bool = False
    vx: float = 0
    vy: float = 0
    seq: int = 0
    input_age: float = 0
    tap_serial: int = 0
    tap_pending: float = 0
    reaction: float = 0
    hp: int = 200
    shield: int = 0
    shield_unlocked: bool = False
    shield_regen: float = 0
    damage_age: float = 0
    blood_seq: int = 0
    shield_seq: int = 0
    damage_seq: int = 0
    kills: int = 0
    deaths: int = 0
    grenade_choice: str = 'grenade'
    throw_choice: str = 'axe'
    flash_time: float = 0
    flash_strength: float = 0
    burn_cooldown: float = 0
    weapon: str = 'rifle'
    magazines: dict = field(default_factory=lambda:{k:v['capacity'] for k,v in WEAPONS.items()})
    reserves: dict = field(default_factory=lambda:{k:v['reserve'] for k,v in WEAPONS.items()})
    heat_cooldown: float = 0
    hazard_cooldown: float = 0
    equip: float = 0
    ammo: int = 30
    reload: float = 0
    cooldown: float = 0
    kick: float = 0
    shot_weapon: str = "rifle"
    cooking: bool = False
    cook_time: float = 0
    cook_blocked: bool = False
    shots: int = 0
    hit: int = 0
    ready: bool = False
    cheats: dict = field(default_factory=lambda:dict.fromkeys(CHEATS,False))
    inp: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    stale: float = 0
    think: float = 0
    route: list = field(default_factory=list)
    brain: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

class Room:
    def __init__(self, code, mode, map_id=DEFAULT_ARENA):
        self.code, self.mode = code, mode
        if map_id not in ARENAS: raise ValueError('존재하지 않는 맵입니다.')
        self.map_id = map_id
        self.players = {}
        self.axes=[]
        self.host = None
        self.state = 'LOBBY'
        self.timer = 0
        self.round = 0
        self.score = [0,0]
        self.history = []
        self.log = []
        self.message = ''
        self.quick = False
        self.train_time = 0.
        self.dynamic_grid = None
        self.crane_index = 0
        self.crane_cycle = 0
        self.crane_state = None
        self.heat_zones = []
        self.next_heat = 4.
        self.fires=[];self.grenades=[];self.explosions=[];self.impacts=[];self.axes=[];self.effect_serial=0

    @property
    def arena(self): return ARENAS[self.map_id]

    @property
    def map(self): return self.dynamic_grid or self.arena['grid']

    def add(self, name, team=0, bot=False):
        if self.state != 'LOBBY': raise ValueError('진행 중인 방입니다.')
        if self.mode == 'ai' and not bot: team = 0
        if sum(p.team == team for p in self.players.values()) >= 3:
            if self.mode == 'ai': raise ValueError('플레이어 팀이 가득 찼습니다.')
            team = 1-team
        if sum(p.team == team for p in self.players.values()) >= 3:
            raise ValueError('방이 가득 찼습니다.')
        p = Player(secrets.token_hex(4), name[:16] or '치터', team, bot)
        p.hp = profile(p.skin)['hp']
        self.players[p.id] = p
        if self.host is None and not bot: self.host = p.id
        return p

    def remove(self, pid):
        p = self.players.get(pid)
        if not p: return
        if p.cooking:self.release_grenade(p,drop=True)
        if self.state in ('PLAYING','COUNTDOWN','ROUND_END'):
            # Keep the match roster but never give replacement AI cheats.
            p.bot = True
            p.name = p.name[:12] + '·AI'
            p.cheats = dict.fromkeys(CHEATS,False)
            p.inp = {}
        else: del self.players[pid]
        humans = [q.id for q in self.players.values() if not q.bot]
        if self.host == pid: self.host = humans[0] if humans else None

    def start_error(self):
        if self.state != 'LOBBY': return '대기실에서만 시작할 수 있습니다.'
        humans = [p for p in self.players.values() if not p.bot]
        if not humans: return '플레이어가 필요합니다.'
        if self.mode == 'local' and not all(any(p.team == t for p in humans) for t in (0,1)):
            return 'BLUE와 RED에 각각 1명 이상 참가해야 합니다.'
        if not all(p.ready for p in humans): return '참가자 전원이 준비해야 합니다. 분할 화면도 각각 준비해 주세요.'
        return ''

    def start(self):
        reason = self.start_error()
        if reason: raise ValueError(reason)
        if self.mode == 'ai':
            for team in (0,1):
                while sum(p.team == team for p in self.players.values()) < 3:
                    i = sum(p.team == team for p in self.players.values())
                    used = {p.skin for p in self.players.values() if p.team==team}
                    skin = next((key for key in ROLES if key not in used),tuple(ROLES)[i])
                    self.add(profile(skin)['name']+' AI '+str(len(self.players)+1),team,True).skin = skin
        self.score, self.history, self.round, self.log = [0,0], [], 0, []
        for p in self.players.values(): p.kills = p.deaths = 0
        self.new_round()

    def new_round(self):
        self.train_time = 0.
        self.dynamic_grid = None
        self.crane_state = None
        self.mechanism_time = 0
        self.heat_zones = []
        self.next_heat = 4.
        self.crane_index = self.crane_cycle = 0
        self.update_mechanisms()
        self.round += 1
        self.state, self.timer = 'COUNTDOWN', 3
        for team in (0,1):
            for i,p in enumerate(q for q in self.players.values() if q.team == team):
                p.x,p.y = self.arena['spawns'][team][i]
                p.yaw = 0 if team == 0 else math.pi
                p.brain = {}
                p.magazines = {k:v['capacity'] for k,v in WEAPONS.items()}
                p.reserves = {k:v['reserve'] for k,v in WEAPONS.items()}
                p.hazard_cooldown = p.heat_cooldown = 0
                p.hp,p.ammo,p.reload,p.cooldown,p.kick = profile(p.skin)['hp'],WEAPONS[p.weapon]['capacity'],0,0,0
                p.flash_time=p.flash_strength=p.burn_cooldown=0
                p.z=p.vz=0;p.crouch=p.jump_held=False;p.cooking=False;p.cook_time=0;p.cook_blocked=False
                p.shield=0;p.shield_unlocked=False;p.damage_age=0;p.shield_regen=0
                p.equip = 0
                p.inp,p.route = {},[]
                p.vx,p.vy,p.stale = 0,0,0
                p.pitch,p.input_age,p.tap_pending,p.reaction = 0,0,0,0
        self.fires=[];self.grenades=[];self.explosions=[];self.impacts=[];self.axes=[]
        self.message = f'ROUND {self.round}'

    def finish(self, winner, reason):
        if self.state != 'PLAYING': return
        self.score[winner] += 1
        self.history.append({'round':self.round,'winner':winner,'reason':reason})
        self.message = ('BLUE' if winner == 0 else 'RED')+' 승리 · '+reason
        self.state, self.timer = ('MATCH_END',0) if self.score[winner] == 3 else ('ROUND_END',4)

    def command(self, p, data):
        op = data.get('type')
        if op == 'input':
            def num(key):
                v = data.get(key,0)
                return max(-1,min(1,float(v))) if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and math.isfinite(v) else 0
            p.inp = {k:num(k) for k in ('f','s','turn')}
            p.inp.update({k:data.get(k) is True for k in ('fire','aim','reload','jump','crouch')})
            yaw = data.get('yaw')
            if isinstance(yaw,(int,float)) and math.isfinite(yaw) and not p.bot and p.hp > 0:
                p.yaw = angle(yaw)
            pitch = data.get('pitch')
            if isinstance(pitch,(int,float)) and math.isfinite(pitch) and not p.bot and p.hp > 0:
                p.pitch = max(-1.15,min(1.15,pitch))
            seq = data.get('seq')
            if isinstance(seq,int) and p.seq < seq <= 2**53:
                p.seq,p.input_age = seq,0
            p.stale = 0
        elif op == 'shoot' and not p.bot and p.hp > 0 and self.state == 'PLAYING':
            serial = data.get('serial')
            if isinstance(serial,int) and p.tap_serial < serial <= 2**53:
                p.tap_serial = serial
                # A tap is an edge, not a short-lived input state. It survives
                # coalesced WebSocket messages but still obeys weapon cadence.
                p.tap_pending = .2
        elif op == 'reload' and not p.bot and p.hp > 0 and self.state == 'PLAYING':
            self.reload_weapon(p)
        elif op == 'weapon' and not p.bot and p.hp > 0 and self.state in ('PLAYING','COUNTDOWN'):
            self.equip_weapon(p,data.get('weapon'))
        elif op == 'toggle' and data.get('key') in CHEATS and not p.bot:
            p.cheats[data['key']] = not p.cheats[data['key']]
            if data['key']=='ammo' and p.cheats['ammo']:p.reload=0
        elif op == 'custom' and self.state == 'LOBBY':
            p.name = str(data.get('name',p.name))[:16] or '치터'
            if isinstance(data.get('skin'),str) and data['skin'] in ROLES:
                p.skin = data['skin'];p.hp = profile(p.skin)['hp']
            team = data.get('team',p.team)
            if team in (0,1) and team != p.team and self.mode == 'local':
                if sum(q.team == team for q in self.players.values()) >= 3: raise ValueError('그 팀은 가득 찼습니다.')
                p.team = team
            self.configure_loadout(p,data)
            p.ready = False
        elif op == 'map' and self.state == 'LOBBY' and self.mode == 'local' and p.id == self.host:
            if data.get('map_id') not in ARENAS: raise ValueError('존재하지 않는 맵입니다.')
            self.map_id = data['map_id']
            for q in self.players.values(): q.ready = False
        elif op == 'ready' and self.state == 'LOBBY':
            p.ready = not p.ready
            if self.mode == 'local' and not self.start_error(): self.start()
        elif op == 'start' and p.id == self.host: self.start()
        elif op == 'lobby' and p.id == self.host and self.state == 'MATCH_END':
            self.players = {i:q for i,q in self.players.items() if not q.bot}
            for q in self.players.values(): q.ready = False
            self.state = 'LOBBY'
        elif op == 'rematch' and p.id == self.host and self.state == 'MATCH_END' and self.quick:
            self.map_id = secrets.choice(tuple(ARENAS))
            self.players = {i:q for i,q in self.players.items() if not q.bot}
            for q in self.players.values(): q.ready = True
            self.state = 'LOBBY'
            self.start()

    def path(self, p, target):
        end = (int(target[0]),int(target[1])) if isinstance(target,(tuple,list)) else (int(target.x),int(target.y))
        start = (int(p.x),int(p.y))
        queue, prev = deque([start]), {start:None}
        while queue:
            v = queue.popleft()
            if v == end: break
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                w = v[0]+dx,v[1]+dy
                if w not in prev and not wall(w[0]+.5,w[1]+.5,self.map):
                    prev[w] = v
                    queue.append(w)
        route = []
        if end in prev:
            while end != start:
                route.append((end[0]+.5,end[1]+.5))
                end = prev[end]
        return route[::-1]

    def ai(self,p,dt):
        from .ai import update_ai
        update_ai(self,p,dt)

    def sight(self,x,y,xx,yy):
        if not clear(x,y,xx,yy,self.map): return False
        config = self.arena.get('train')
        if config:
            train = train_pose(self.train_time,config)
            if train['active']:
                for car in config['cars']:
                    cx=train['x']+car['offset']
                    if segment_box(x,y,xx,yy,cx-car['length']/2,train['y']-car['width']/2,cx+car['length']/2,train['y']+car['width']/2):return False
        return True

    def assist_aim(self,p):
        """Acquire a visible enemy before the shot, including queued mobile taps."""
        if p.bot or p.hp <= 0 or not p.cheats['aim'] or self.state != 'PLAYING': return
        targets = [q for q in self.players.values() if q.team != p.team and q.hp > 0
                   and math.hypot(q.x-p.x,q.y-p.y) <= WEAPONS[p.weapon]['range']
                   and abs(angle(math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)-p.yaw)) < AIM_CONE
                   and self.sight(p.x,p.y,q.x,q.y)]
        if not targets: return
        q = min(targets,key=lambda q:(abs(angle(math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)-p.yaw)),math.hypot(q.x-p.x,q.y-p.y),q.id))
        p.yaw = math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)
        p.pitch = math.atan2(q.z+1.2*(.65 if q.crouch else 1)-p.z-(.975 if p.crouch else 1.5),math.hypot(q.x-p.x,q.y-p.y))

    def configure_loadout(self,p,data):
        if self.state!='LOBBY':return
        for field,allowed in (('grenade_choice',GRENADE_TYPES),('throw_choice',THROW_TYPES)):
            if isinstance(data.get(field),str) and data[field] in allowed:setattr(p,field,data[field])
        if p.weapon in GRENADE_TYPES+THROW_TYPES and not self.loadout_allows(p,p.weapon):p.weapon='rifle';p.ammo=p.magazines['rifle']

    def loadout_allows(self,p,key):
        return key in WEAPONS and (key not in GRENADE_TYPES or key==p.grenade_choice) and (key not in THROW_TYPES or key==p.throw_choice)

    def swing_knife(self,p):
        if p.cooldown>0 or p.equip>0 or p.reload>0:return
        p.cooldown=WEAPONS['knife']['interval'];p.shots+=1;p.shot_weapon='knife'
        targets=[]
        for q in self.players.values():
            d=math.hypot(q.x-p.x,q.y-p.y)
            if q.hp>0 and q.team!=p.team and d<=2.2 and abs(angle(math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)-p.yaw))<.65 and abs(q.z-p.z)<1.6 and self.sight(p.x,p.y,q.x,q.y):targets.append((d,q.id,q))
        if targets:self.weapon_damage(p,min(targets,key=lambda v:v[:2])[2],70,'knife')

    def equip_weapon(self,p,key):
        if not isinstance(key,str) or not self.loadout_allows(p,key) or key == p.weapon or p.equip > 0: return
        if not self.available(p,key):return
        if p.cooking:self.release_grenade(p,drop=True)
        p.magazines[p.weapon] = p.ammo
        p.weapon = key
        p.ammo = p.magazines[key]
        p.reload = 0
        p.equip = .35
        p.cooldown = max(p.cooldown,.35)
        p.tap_pending = 0

    def reload_weapon(self,p):
        spec = WEAPONS[p.weapon]
        if p.cooking or spec['kind']=='melee' or (p.cheats.get('ammo') and not p.bot):return
        if p.ammo < spec['capacity'] and p.reload == 0 and p.equip == 0 and p.reserves[p.weapon] > 0:
            p.reload = spec['reload_time']

    def shoot(self,p):
        spec = WEAPONS[p.weapon]
        if p.cooking:return
        if p.weapon in GRENADE_TYPES and not p.bot and p.inp.get('fire'):
            self.prime_grenade(p);return
        if spec['kind']=='melee':
            self.swing_knife(p);return
        infinite=p.weapon!='axe' and not p.bot and p.cheats.get('ammo',False)
        if infinite:p.reload=0
        if p.weapon == 'shotgun' and p.ammo > 0 and p.reload > 0 and p.cooldown == 0 and p.equip == 0:
            p.reload = 0
        if p.cooldown > 0 or p.reload > 0 or p.equip > 0: return
        if p.ammo <= 0 and not infinite:
            self.reload_weapon(p)
            return
        p.cooldown = max(.30,spec['interval']) if p.bot else spec['interval']
        p.shot_weapon=p.weapon
        p.shots += 1
        if not infinite:p.ammo -= 1
        p.magazines[p.weapon] = p.ammo
        self.assist_aim(p)
        if spec['kind']=='throw':
            self.throw_axe(p);self.auto_weapon(p);return
        if spec['kind']=='grenade':
            p.brain['pending_grenade']=False
            self.throw_grenade(p);return
        recoil = random.uniform(-.09,.09) if p.bot else (0 if p.cheats['recoil'] else random.uniform(-p.kick,p.kick))
        damage = {};self._head_target=None
        # Each pellet traces independently, hits the nearest visible enemy and
        # never penetrates walls, the train, or another enemy. No client hit list.
        for i in range(spec['pellets']):
            if spec['pellets'] > 1:
                theta = i * math.pi * (3-math.sqrt(5))
                radius = math.sqrt((i+.5)/spec['pellets']) * spec['spread']
                horizontal,vertical = math.cos(theta)*radius,math.sin(theta)*radius
            else:
                horizontal,vertical = random.uniform(-spec['spread'],spec['spread']),0
            direction = p.yaw + recoil + horizontal
            candidates = []
            for q in self.players.values():
                if q.hp <= 0 or q.team == p.team: continue
                d = math.hypot(q.x-p.x,q.y-p.y)
                scale=.65 if q.crouch else 1
                height = p.z+( .975 if p.crouch else 1.5)+math.tan(p.pitch+vertical)*d-q.z
                if d <= spec['range'] and 0 < height < 1.96*scale and abs(angle(math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)-direction)) <= math.atan2(.56,d) :
                    candidates.append((d,q))
            impact=bullet_impact(self,p,direction,p.pitch+vertical,spec['range'])
            if impact and candidates:candidates=[c for c in candidates if c[0]/max(.01,math.cos(p.pitch+vertical))<impact['distance']+.12]
            if not candidates and impact:self.add_impact(impact)
            if candidates:
                d,q = min(candidates,key=lambda z:z[0])
                falloff = max(.2,1-max(0,d-7)/25) if p.weapon == 'shotgun' else 1
                height=p.z+(.975 if p.crouch else 1.5)+math.tan(p.pitch+vertical)*d-q.z
                head=p.weapon in ('rifle','pistol') and height>=1.56*(.65 if q.crouch else 1) and abs(angle(math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)-direction))<=math.atan2(.16,d)
                amount = max(1,round(spec['damage']*falloff*(.64 if p.bot else 1)*(2 if head else 1)))
                if head:self._head_target=q.id
                damage[q.id] = damage.get(q.id,0) + amount
        if not p.cheats['recoil']: p.kick = min(.13,p.kick+spec['recoil'])
        for pid,amount in damage.items():
            q = self.players[pid]
            self.weapon_damage(p,q,amount,p.weapon,headshot=q.id==self._head_target)

    def tick(self,dt):
        if self.state in ('COUNTDOWN','ROUND_END'):
            self.timer -= dt
            if self.timer <= 0:
                if self.state == 'COUNTDOWN': self.state,self.timer = 'PLAYING',120
                else: self.new_round()
            return
        if self.state != 'PLAYING': return
        self.timer -= dt
        train_before = self.train_time
        self.train_time += dt
        self.update_mechanisms()
        self.update_heat()
        self.update_grenades(dt)
        self.update_axes(dt)
        self.update_fires(dt)
        train_config = self.arena.get('train')
        for p in list(self.players.values()):
            if p.hp <= 0: continue
            old_position = (p.x,p.y)
            if not p.bot:
                p.stale += dt
                if p.stale > .4:p.inp={}
            if not p.inp.get('fire'):p.cook_blocked=False
            p.crouch=bool(p.inp.get("crouch"))
            jump=bool(p.inp.get("jump"))
            if jump and not p.jump_held and p.z<=0:
                height=1.1*({"scout":1.2,"guard":.9}.get(p.skin,1))
                p.vz=math.sqrt(2*18*height)
            p.jump_held=jump
            if p.z>0 or p.vz>0:
                p.z=max(0,p.z+p.vz*dt-9*dt*dt);p.vz-=18*dt
                if p.z==0:p.vz=0
            p.flash_time=max(0,p.flash_time-dt)
            if p.flash_time==0:p.flash_strength=0
            p.heat_cooldown = max(0,p.heat_cooldown-dt)
            p.hazard_cooldown = max(0,p.hazard_cooldown-dt)
            p.cooldown = max(0,p.cooldown-dt)
            p.equip = max(0,p.equip-dt)
            spec = WEAPONS[p.weapon]
            p.kick = max(0,p.kick-dt*.055)
            if p.reload > 0:
                p.reload = max(0,p.reload-dt)
                if p.reload == 0:
                    amount = min(1 if p.weapon == 'shotgun' else spec['capacity']-p.ammo, p.reserves[p.weapon])
                    p.ammo += amount
                    p.reserves[p.weapon] -= amount
                    p.magazines[p.weapon] = p.ammo
                    if p.weapon == 'shotgun' and p.ammo < spec['capacity'] and p.reserves[p.weapon] > 0:
                        p.reload = spec['reload_time']
            if p.bot:
                ox,oy = p.x,p.y
                self.ai(p,dt)
                p.vx,p.vy = (p.x-ox)/dt,(p.y-oy)/dt
            else:
                p.yaw = angle(p.yaw+p.inp.get('turn',0)*3.2*dt)
                f,s = p.inp.get('f',0),p.inp.get('s',0)
                walk(p,f,s,dt,p.inp.get('aim'),self.map)
                p.input_age += dt
            self.update_shield(p,dt)
            if train_config and train_hits(train_before,self.train_time,old_position,(p.x,p.y),train_config):
                self.environment_damage(p,train_config['damage'],'기차','train')
                if p.hp<=0:continue
            if self.heat_hit(p,old_position,train_before,self.train_time):
                continue
            if self.clock_hit(p,old_position,train_before,self.train_time):
                continue
            if p.cooking:
                p.cook_time=min(3,p.cook_time+dt)
                if p.cook_time>=3-1e-8:
                    self.detonate_held(p)
                    if p.hp<=0:continue
                elif not p.inp.get('fire'):self.release_grenade(p)
            if p.inp.get('aim') or p.inp.get('fire') or p.tap_pending > 0:
                self.assist_aim(p)
            if p.inp.get('reload'): self.reload_weapon(p)
            if p.inp.get('fire') or p.tap_pending > 0:
                shots = p.shots
                self.shoot(p)
                if p.shots > shots: p.tap_pending = 0
            p.tap_pending = max(0,p.tap_pending-dt)
            if p.ammo==0 and p.reserves[p.weapon]==0:self.auto_weapon(p)
        alive = [sum(p.hp>0 and p.team==t for p in self.players.values()) for t in (0,1)]
        if alive == [0,0]:
            self.round -= 1
            self.new_round()
            self.message = '양 팀 동시 녹아웃 · 같은 라운드 재시작'
        elif 0 in alive: self.finish(0 if alive[0] else 1,'전원 녹아웃')
        elif self.timer <= 0:
            values = [(alive[t],sum(p.hp for p in self.players.values() if p.team==t)) for t in (0,1)]
            if values[0] != values[1]: self.finish(0 if values[0]>values[1] else 1,'시간 종료 · 생존자/체력 우세')
            else:
                self.timer = 30
                self.message = '동률 · 30초 연장전'

    def update_mechanisms(self):
        cfg=self.arena.get('crane')
        if not cfg: return
        t=self.train_time;cycle=self.crane_cycle;phase=t-cycle*cfg['period']
        elapsed=max(0,t-getattr(self,'mechanism_time',0));self.mechanism_time=t
        previous_lift=(self.crane_state or {}).get('lift',0)
        descent=max(0,previous_lift-6*elapsed)
        source=cfg['pads'][self.crane_index];target=cfg['pads'][1-self.crane_index]
        moving=phase>=cfg['warning'] and cycle>=self.crane_cycle
        progress=min(1,max(0,(phase-cfg['warning'])/cfg['travel'])) if moving else 0
        blocked=any(p.hp>0 and target[0]-.5<p.x<target[0]+target[2]+.5 and target[1]-.5<p.y<target[1]+target[3]+.5 for p in self.players.values())
        if moving and progress>=1 and descent<=0:
            self.crane_index=1-self.crane_index;self.crane_cycle=int(t/cfg['period'])+1
            source=cfg['pads'][self.crane_index];moving=False;progress=0
        # Load descends on schedule; the landing zone is dangerous to both teams.
        travel=max(0,min(1,(progress-.2)/.6))
        x=source[0]+(target[0]-source[0])*travel
        y=source[1]+(target[1]-source[1])*travel
        lift=min(1,progress*5,(1-progress)*5)*7 if moving else 0
        if moving and progress>=1: lift=descent
        self.crane_state=dict(x=x,y=y,w=source[2],h=source[3],lift=lift,moving=moving,blocked=blocked,warning=0<=phase<cfg['warning'],progress=progress)
        if self.state == 'PLAYING' and previous_lift>lift and lift<1.9:
            for p in self.players.values():
                if p.hp>0 and x-PLAYER_RADIUS<p.x<x+source[2]+PLAYER_RADIUS and y-PLAYER_RADIUS<p.y<y+source[3]+PLAYER_RADIUS:
                    self.environment_damage(p,p.hp+p.shield,'컨테이너 압사','crane')
        # Raised loads stop blocking floor travel/shots; low loads use conservative cells.
        grid=[list(row) for row in self.arena['grid']]
        if lift<2.1:
            for yy in range(int(y),math.ceil(y+source[3])):
                for xx in range(int(x),math.ceil(x+source[2])): grid[yy][xx]='1'
        result=[''.join(row) for row in grid]
        if result!=self.dynamic_grid:
            self.dynamic_grid=result;self._cover_cache={}
            for p in self.players.values():
                p.route=[]
                if p.brain: p.brain['plan']=0

    def update_shield(self,p,dt):
        p.damage_age+=dt
        cfg=self.arena.get('shield')
        if not cfg:return
        if not p.shield_unlocked and math.hypot(p.x-cfg['x'],p.y-cfg['y'])<=cfg['radius']:
            p.shield_unlocked=True;p.shield=cfg['capacity'];p.shield_regen=0
        elif p.shield_unlocked and p.damage_age>cfg['delay'] and p.shield<cfg['capacity']:
            p.shield_regen+=min(dt,p.damage_age-cfg['delay'])*cfg['regen']
            amount=int(p.shield_regen+1e-8);p.shield_regen-=amount;p.shield=min(cfg['capacity'],p.shield+amount)

    def apply_damage(self,p,amount,blood=False):
        if p.hp<=0 or amount<=0:return False
        p.damage_age=0;p.shield_regen=0;p.damage_seq+=1
        absorbed=min(p.shield,amount);p.shield-=absorbed
        if absorbed:p.shield_seq+=1
        remaining=amount-absorbed
        if remaining>0:
            p.hp=max(0,p.hp-remaining)
            if blood:p.blood_seq+=1
        return p.hp<=0

    def weapon_damage(self,attacker,target,amount,weapon,headshot=False):
        if target.hp<=0:return
        self.apply_damage(target,amount,True)
        if attacker and attacker.id!=target.id:attacker.hit+=1
        if target.hp<=0:
            if target.cooking:self.release_grenade(target,drop=True)
            target.deaths+=1;target.z=target.vz=0;target.vx=target.vy=0;target.inp={}
            if attacker and attacker.id!=target.id:attacker.kills+=1
            self.log.append(dict(killer=attacker.name if attacker else '수류탄',victim=target.name,team=attacker.team if attacker else None,weapon=weapon,headshot=headshot));self.log=self.log[-6:]

    def add_impact(self,impact):
        self.effect_serial+=1;self.impacts.append(dict(id=self.effect_serial,time=round(self.train_time,3),**{k:round(v,4) if isinstance(v,float) else v for k,v in impact.items()}));self.impacts=self.impacts[-128:]

    def available(self,p,key):
        if not self.loadout_allows(p,key):return False
        if key=='knife':return True
        if key!='axe' and p.cheats.get('ammo') and not p.bot:return True
        return (p.ammo if key==p.weapon else p.magazines[key])+p.reserves[key]>0

    def auto_weapon(self,p):
        if p.cooking:return
        if self.available(p,p.weapon):return
        for key in ('rifle','pistol','shotgun',p.grenade_choice,p.throw_choice,'knife'):
            if self.available(p,key):self.equip_weapon(p,key);break

    def throw_axe(self,p):
        self.effect_serial+=1;speed=WEAPONS[p.weapon].get('speed',17)
        if p.weapon!='axe' and len([a for a in self.axes if a['owner']==p.id and a.get('weapon')==p.weapon])>=20:
            old=next(a for a in self.axes if a['owner']==p.id and a.get('weapon')==p.weapon);self.axes.remove(old)
        self.axes.append(dict(id=self.effect_serial,owner=p.id,weapon=p.weapon,x=p.x,y=p.y,z=p.z+(.975 if p.crouch else 1.5),vx=speed*math.cos(p.yaw)*math.cos(p.pitch),vy=speed*math.sin(p.yaw)*math.cos(p.pitch),vz=2+speed*math.sin(p.pitch),ground=False))
        if p.weapon!='axe' and p.ammo==0:self.reload_weapon(p)

    def update_axes(self,dt):
        boxes=world_geometry(self)
        remaining=[]
        for a in self.axes:
            owner=self.players.get(a['owner'])
            if not owner:continue
            retrieved=False;key=a.get('weapon','axe');recover=False
            steps=max(1,math.ceil(dt/(1/120)))
            for _ in range(steps):
                advance(a,dt/steps,'axe',boxes,self.arena['grid'])
                if a['ground']:
                    if owner.hp>0 and owner.z<.5 and math.hypot(owner.x-a['x'],owner.y-a['y'])<1.25:retrieved=True;recover=True
                    break
                for q in self.players.values():
                    scale=.65 if q.crouch else 1
                    if q.id!=owner.id and q.hp>0 and math.hypot(q.x-a['x'],q.y-a['y'])<.5 and q.z<a['z']<q.z+1.96*scale:
                        if q.team!=owner.team:
                            head=a['z']>q.z+1.56*scale
                            self.weapon_damage(owner,q,WEAPONS[key]['damage']*(2 if head else 1),key,headshot=head)
                        retrieved=True;break
                if retrieved:break
            if retrieved:
                if key=='axe' or recover:
                    amount=min(WEAPONS[key]['capacity'],(owner.ammo if owner.weapon==key else owner.magazines[key])+1)
                    owner.magazines[key]=amount
                    if owner.weapon==key:owner.ammo=amount
            else:remaining.append(a)
        self.axes=remaining

    def prime_grenade(self,p):
        infinite=not p.bot and p.cheats.get('ammo',False)
        if p.cooking or p.cook_blocked or p.weapon not in GRENADE_TYPES or p.hp<=0 or self.state!='PLAYING' or p.equip>0 or p.cooldown>0 or p.reload>0:return False
        if p.ammo<=0 and not infinite:
            self.reload_weapon(p);return False
        if not infinite:p.ammo-=1
        p.magazines[p.weapon]=p.ammo
        p.cooking=True;p.cook_time=0;p.cook_blocked=True;p.tap_pending=0;p.reload=0
        return True

    def release_grenade(self,p,drop=False):
        if not p.cooking:return
        fuse=max(0,3-p.cook_time);p.cooking=False;p.cook_time=0
        p.shots+=1;p.shot_weapon=p.weapon;p.cooldown=max(p.cooldown,WEAPONS[p.weapon]['interval'])
        self.throw_grenade(p,fuse=fuse,drop=drop)

    def detonate_held(self,p):
        p.cooking=False;p.cook_time=0;p.shots+=1;p.shot_weapon=p.weapon
        p.cooldown=max(p.cooldown,WEAPONS[p.weapon]['interval'])
        g=dict(kind=p.weapon,owner=p.id,team=p.team,x=p.x,y=p.y,z=p.z+(.585 if p.crouch else .9))
        self.explode_grenade(g)
        if p.hp>0 and p.ammo==0:self.reload_weapon(p)

    def throw_grenade(self,p,fuse=None,drop=False):
        self.effect_serial+=1;speed=0 if drop else 13*math.cos(p.pitch)
        self.grenades.append(dict(id=self.effect_serial,kind=p.weapon,owner=p.id,team=p.team,x=p.x,y=p.y,z=p.z+(.9 if p.crouch else 1.35),vx=math.cos(p.yaw)*speed,vy=math.sin(p.yaw)*speed,vz=0 if drop else 4.2+math.sin(p.pitch)*8,fuse=3. if fuse is None else fuse))
        if p.ammo==0 and p.hp>0:self.reload_weapon(p)

    def projectile_blocked(self,x,y,z):
        if not (0<=x<60 and 0<=y<35):return True
        if any(a<=x<=d and b<=y<=e and c<=z<=f for a,b,c,d,e,f in self.arena.get('ballistic_solids',[])):return True
        crane=self.crane_state
        if crane and crane['x']<=x<=crane['x']+crane['w'] and crane['y']<=y<=crane['y']+crane['h']:
            return crane['lift']<=z<=crane['lift']+2.6
        if wall(x,y,self.map) and z<(3.8 if int(x) in (0,59) or int(y) in (0,34) else 2.6):return True
        cfg=self.arena.get('train')
        if cfg and z<4.8:
            pose=train_pose(self.train_time,cfg)
            if pose['active'] and any(abs(x-pose['x']-c['offset'])<c['length']/2 and abs(y-cfg['y'])<c['width']/2 for c in cfg['cars']):return True
        return False

    def blast_clear(self,g,q):
        steps=max(1,math.ceil(math.sqrt((q.x-g['x'])**2+(q.y-g['y'])**2+(q.z+(.585 if q.crouch else .9)-g['z'])**2)/.15))
        return all(not self.projectile_blocked(g['x']+(q.x-g['x'])*i/steps,g['y']+(q.y-g['y'])*i/steps,g['z']+(q.z+(.585 if q.crouch else .9)-g['z'])*i/steps) for i in range(1,steps+1))

    def explode_grenade(self,g):
        self.effect_serial+=1;kind=g.get('kind','grenade')
        self.explosions.append(dict(id=self.effect_serial,kind=kind,x=g['x'],y=g['y'],z=g['z'],time=self.train_time))
        if kind=='flashbang':
            for q in self.players.values():
                d=math.hypot(q.x-g['x'],q.y-g['y'])
                if q.hp<=0 or d>12 or (q.team==g['team'] and q.id!=g['owner']) or not self.blast_clear(g,q):continue
                facing=(1+math.cos(angle(math.atan2(g['y']-q.y,g['x']-q.x)-q.yaw)))/2
                strength=max(.15,(1-d/12)*(.3+.7*facing));q.flash_strength=max(q.flash_strength,strength);q.flash_time=max(q.flash_time,4*strength)
            return
        if kind=='molotov':
            x,y=safe_floor(g['x'],g['y'],self.arena['grid'],world_geometry(self))
            self.fires.append(dict(id=self.effect_serial,owner=g['owner'],team=g['team'],x=x,y=y,z=.04,radius=3.,end=self.train_time+8));return
        attacker=self.players.get(g['owner'])
        for q in self.players.values():
            if q.hp<=0 or (q.team==g['team'] and q.id!=g['owner']):continue
            distance=math.sqrt((q.x-g['x'])**2+(q.y-g['y'])**2+(q.z+(.585 if q.crouch else .9)-g['z'])**2)
            if distance>6 or not self.blast_clear(g,q):continue
            amount=round(160*max(.12,1-distance/6))
            self.weapon_damage(attacker,q,amount,'grenade')

    def update_grenades(self,dt):
        self.explosions=[e for e in self.explosions if self.train_time-e['time']<2]
        boxes=world_geometry(self);remaining=[]
        batch,self.grenades=self.grenades,[]
        for g in batch:
            active=min(dt,max(0,g['fuse']));steps=max(1,math.ceil(active/(1/120)))
            struck=False
            for _ in range(steps):
                old=(g['vx'],g['vy'],g['vz'])
                advance(g,active/steps,'grenade',boxes,self.arena['grid'])
                if g.get('kind')=='molotov' and (g['z']<=.135 or g['vx']*old[0]+g['vy']*old[1]<-1e-6 or g['vz']>old[2]+.02):struck=True;break
            g['fuse']-=dt
            if g['fuse']>1e-7 and not struck:remaining.append(g)
            else:self.explode_grenade(g)
        # A casualty may drop a second armed grenade while explosions resolve.
        self.grenades=remaining+self.grenades

    def update_fires(self,dt):
        self.fires=[f for f in self.fires if f['end']>self.train_time]
        for q in list(self.players.values()):
            q.burn_cooldown=max(0,q.burn_cooldown-dt)
            if q.hp<=0 or q.burn_cooldown>0:continue
            for f in self.fires:
                if (q.team==f['team'] and q.id!=f['owner']) or abs(q.z-f['z'])>1.3:continue
                if math.hypot(q.x-f['x'],q.y-f['y'])<f['radius'] and self.blast_clear(f,q):
                    self.weapon_damage(self.players.get(f['owner']),q,20,'molotov');q.burn_cooldown=.4;break

    def environment_damage(self,p,amount,name,cause):
        if p.hp<=0: return
        self.apply_damage(p,amount)
        if p.hp==0:
            if p.cooking:self.release_grenade(p,drop=True)
            p.deaths+=1;p.z=p.vz=0;p.vx=p.vy=0;p.inp={}
            self.log.append(dict(killer=name,victim=p.name,team=None,cause=cause))
            self.log=self.log[-6:]

    def update_heat(self):
        self.heat_zones=[z for z in self.heat_zones if z['end']>self.train_time]
        if self.map_id!='foundry' or self.train_time<self.next_heat: return
        self.next_heat=self.train_time+8
        candidates=[]
        for y in range(4,31):
            for x in range(4,56):
                if all(not wall(x+.5+dx,y+.5+dy,self.map) for dx,dy in [(0,0),(2.8,0),(-2.8,0),(0,2.8),(0,-2.8),(2,2),(-2,2),(2,-2),(-2,-2)]):candidates.append((x+.5,y+.5))
        random.shuffle(candidates)
        selected=[]
        for x,y in candidates:
            if all(math.hypot(x-a,y-b)>6 for a,b in selected):selected.append((x,y))
            if len(selected)==3:break
        self.heat_zones=[dict(x=x,y=y,radius=2.8,start=self.train_time+2,end=self.train_time+6) for x,y in selected]

    def heat_hit(self,p,old,t0,t1):
        if p.z>.28 or profile(p.skin)['heat_immune'] or p.heat_cooldown>0 or t1<=t0:return False
        for z in self.heat_zones:
            start,end=max(t0,z['start']),min(t1,z['end'])
            if end<=start:continue
            u,v=(start-t0)/(t1-t0),(end-t0)/(t1-t0)
            ax=old[0]+(p.x-old[0])*u;ay=old[1]+(p.y-old[1])*u
            bx=old[0]+(p.x-old[0])*v;by=old[1]+(p.y-old[1])*v
            dx,dy=bx-ax,by-ay
            f=max(0,min(1,((z['x']-ax)*dx+(z['y']-ay)*dy)/max(1e-9,dx*dx+dy*dy)))
            if math.hypot(ax+f*dx-z['x'],ay+f*dy-z['y'])<z['radius']+PLAYER_RADIUS:
                self.environment_damage(p,25,'용융 철 장판','heat');p.heat_cooldown=.5
                return p.hp<=0
        return False

    def clock_hit(self,p,old,t0,t1):
        cfg=self.arena.get('clock')
        if not cfg or p.hazard_cooldown>0 or p.z>1.15: return False
        # Sweep player and rotating hand at <= .04 radians and .2 m intervals.
        steps=max(1,math.ceil((t1-t0)*2*math.pi/cfg['period']/.04),math.ceil(math.dist(old,(p.x,p.y))/.2))
        for i in range(steps+1):
            u=i/steps;a=(t0+(t1-t0)*u)*2*math.pi/cfg['period']
            dx=old[0]+(p.x-old[0])*u-cfg['x'];dy=old[1]+(p.y-old[1])*u-cfg['y']
            along=dx*math.cos(a)+dy*math.sin(a);across=-dx*math.sin(a)+dy*math.cos(a)
            if cfg['inner']-PLAYER_RADIUS<along<cfg['length']+PLAYER_RADIUS and abs(across)<cfg['width']/2+PLAYER_RADIUS and not wall(p.x,p.y,self.map):
                self.apply_damage(p,cfg['damage']);p.hazard_cooldown=cfg['hit_interval']
                if p.hp==0:
                    if p.cooking:self.release_grenade(p,drop=True)
                    p.deaths+=1;p.z=p.vz=0;p.vx=p.vy=0;p.inp={}
                    self.log.append(dict(killer='시계탑 시침',victim=p.name,team=None,cause='clock'));self.log=self.log[-6:]
                    return True
                break
        return False

    def snapshot(self):
        players = []
        for p in self.players.values():
            d = asdict(p)
            d.update(max_hp=profile(p.skin)['hp'],speed_multiplier=profile(p.skin)['speed'],role_name=profile(p.skin)['name'])
            for k in ('inp','route','think','stale','tap_pending','tap_serial','reaction','brain','shield_regen'): d.pop(k)
            players.append(d)
        train = train_pose(self.train_time,self.arena['train']) if 'train' in self.arena else None
        reason = self.start_error()
        return dict(type='state',fires=self.fires,projectile_boxes=world_geometry(self),axes=self.axes,grenades=self.grenades,explosions=self.explosions,impacts=self.impacts,world_time=self.train_time,heat_zones=self.heat_zones,crane=self.crane_state,grid=self.map,weapons=WEAPONS,can_start=not reason,start_hint=reason,train=train,map_id=self.map_id,arena=self.arena,code=self.code,mode=self.mode,quick=self.quick,host=self.host,state=self.state,timer=max(0,self.timer),round=self.round,score=self.score,history=self.history,log=self.log,message=self.message,players=players)
``````

## backend/hazards.py

``````python
"""Server-owned periodic train motion and continuous collision tests (metres)."""
import math
from .arenas import PLAYER_RADIUS


def train_pose(elapsed, config):
    phase = elapsed % config['period']
    travel = (config['end']-config['start']) / config['speed']
    active = config['warning'] <= phase < config['warning']+travel
    x = config['start'] + config['speed']*(phase-config['warning']) if active else config['start']
    return dict(elapsed=elapsed, x=x, y=config['y'], active=active,
                warning=phase < config['warning'],
                next_in=config['warning']-phase if phase < config['warning'] else config['period']-phase+config['warning'])


def segment_box(x0, y0, x1, y1, left, bottom, right, top):
    """Closed segment vs AABB, including starting overlaps and parallel edges."""
    enter, leave = 0., 1.
    for origin, delta, lo, hi in ((x0,x1-x0,left,right),(y0,y1-y0,bottom,top)):
        if abs(delta) < 1e-12:
            if not lo <= origin <= hi: return False
        else:
            a,b = sorted(((lo-origin)/delta,(hi-origin)/delta))
            enter,leave = max(enter,a),min(leave,b)
            if enter > leave: return False
    return True


def train_hits(t0, t1, old, new, config):
    """Sweep relative movement; split at off-map resets to avoid ghost impacts."""
    if t1 <= t0: return False
    travel = (config['end']-config['start'])/config['speed']
    for cycle in range(math.floor(t0/config['period']),math.floor(t1/config['period'])+1):
        start = cycle*config['period']+config['warning']
        a,b = max(t0,start),min(t1,start+travel)
        if b < a: continue
        u,v = (a-t0)/(t1-t0),(b-t0)/(t1-t0)
        ax = old[0]+(new[0]-old[0])*u-(config['start']+config['speed']*(a-start))
        bx = old[0]+(new[0]-old[0])*v-(config['start']+config['speed']*(b-start))
        ay = old[1]+(new[1]-old[1])*u-config['y']
        by = old[1]+(new[1]-old[1])*v-config['y']
        hx,hy = config['length']/2+PLAYER_RADIUS,config['width']/2+PLAYER_RADIUS
        for car in config.get('cars',[dict(offset=0,length=config['length'],width=config['width'])]):
            hx,hy=car['length']/2+PLAYER_RADIUS,car['width']/2+PLAYER_RADIUS
            if segment_box(ax-car['offset'],ay,bx-car['offset'],by,-hx,-hy,hx,hy):return True
    return False
``````

## backend/main.py

``````python
import asyncio
import contextlib
import json
import secrets
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from .game import Room, MAP
from .roles import ROLES
from .arenas import ARENAS, DEFAULT_ARENA

logger=logging.getLogger('cheat-fps')
simulation_task=None
rooms = {}
peers = {}
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'frontend'

async def simulation():
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    last = loop.time()
    accumulator = 0
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(1/60)
        now = loop.time()
        dt,last = min(.1,now-last),now
        failed=[]
        for code,room in list(rooms.items()):
            try:room.tick(dt)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception('Match %s failed',code);failed.append(code)
        for ws,peer in list(peers.items()):
            if peer['room'].code in failed:
                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):await ws.send_json({'type':'error','message':'경기 처리 오류가 발생했다. 게임을 다시 시작해 주세요.'});await ws.close(code=1011)
        for code in failed:rooms.pop(code,None)
        accumulator += dt
        if accumulator >= 1/30:
            accumulator %= 1/30
            snapshots = {code:json.dumps(room.snapshot(),separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False) for code,room in rooms.items()}
            for ws,peer in list(peers.items()):
                if peer['room'].code not in snapshots:continue
                q = peer['queue']
                if q.full():
                    with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.QueueEmpty): q.get_nowait()
                q.put_nowait(snapshots[peer['room'].code])

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app):
    global simulation_task
    task = simulation_task = asyncio.create_task(simulation())
    yield
    task.cancel()
    with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError): await task

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
app.mount('/static', StaticFiles(directory=ROOT), name='static')

@app.get('/')
async def index(): return FileResponse(ROOT / 'index.html',headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache'})

@app.get('/health')
async def health():
    healthy=simulation_task is not None and not simulation_task.done()
    return JSONResponse({'status':'ok' if healthy else 'error','version':'0.8.1','build':'0.8.1','rooms':len(rooms)},status_code=200 if healthy else 503)

@app.get('/arena')
async def arena(): return {'map':MAP}

@app.get('/roles')
async def roles(): return {'base_hp':200,'roles':ROLES}

@app.get('/arenas')
async def arenas(): return {'arenas':list(ARENAS.values())}

async def sender(ws,queue):
    while True:
        data = await queue.get()
        await asyncio.wait_for(ws.send_text(data) if isinstance(data,str) else ws.send_json(data),timeout=5)

@app.websocket('/ws')
async def socket(ws:WebSocket):
    await ws.accept()
    room = None
    owned = []
    task = None
    try:
        raw = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive_text(),10)
        if len(raw)>4096: return
        hello = json.loads(raw)
        code = str(hello.get('code','')).strip().upper()
        if code:
            room = rooms.get(code)
            if not room: raise ValueError('방 코드를 확인해 주세요.')
        else:
            if len(rooms)>=100: raise ValueError('서버가 가득 찼습니다.')
            code = secrets.token_hex(3).upper()
            while code in rooms: code = secrets.token_hex(3).upper()
            mode = 'local' if hello.get('mode')=='local' else 'ai'
            chosen = hello.get('map_id',DEFAULT_ARENA) if mode=='local' else secrets.choice(tuple(ARENAS))
            room = Room(code,mode,chosen)
            rooms[code] = room
        count = 2 if hello.get('split') is True else 1
        free = (3 if room.mode=='ai' else 6)-len([p for p in room.players.values() if not p.bot])
        if count > free: raise ValueError('요청한 인원만큼 빈 자리가 없습니다.')
        for i in range(count):
            p = room.add(str(hello.get('name','치터'))+(f' P{i+1}' if count>1 else ''),i if count>1 else 0)
            skins = hello.get('skins',[])
            if isinstance(skins,list) and i < len(skins) and isinstance(skins[i],str) and skins[i] in ROLES:
                p.skin = skins[i];p.hp = ROLES[p.skin]['hp']
            equipment=hello.get('equipment',[])
            if isinstance(equipment,list) and i<len(equipment) and isinstance(equipment[i],dict):room.configure_loadout(p,equipment[i])
            loadouts = hello.get('cheats',[])
            if isinstance(loadouts,list) and i < len(loadouts) and isinstance(loadouts[i],dict):
                p.cheats = {key:loadouts[i].get(key) is True for key in p.cheats}
            owned.append(p.id)
        # AI quick play still has a private server match; there is no room UI.
        if room.mode == 'ai' and hello.get('quick') is True and not hello.get('code'):
            room.quick = True
            for pid in owned: room.players[pid].ready = True
            room.start()
        await ws.send_json({'type':'welcome','version':'0.8.1','build':'0.8.1','ids':owned,'map':room.map,'map_id':room.map_id,'arena':room.arena,'code':code,'quick':room.quick})
        queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=3)
        peers[ws] = {'room':room,'queue':queue}
        task = asyncio.create_task(sender(ws,queue))
        window,count_msg = asyncio.get_running_loop().time(),0
        while True:
            raw = await ws.receive_text()
            if len(raw)>4096: await ws.close(code=1009); break
            now = asyncio.get_running_loop().time()
            if now-window>=1: window,count_msg=now,0
            count_msg += 1
            if count_msg>150: continue
            try:
                data = json.loads(raw)
                if not isinstance(data,dict): continue
                if data.get('type') == 'ping':
                    if not queue.full(): queue.put_nowait({'type':'pong','sent':data.get('sent')})
                    continue
                pid = data.get('id',owned[0])
                if pid in owned and pid in room.players: room.command(room.players[pid],data)
            except (ValueError,TypeError) as e:
                if not queue.full(): queue.put_nowait({'type':'error','message':str(e)})
    except (WebSocketDisconnect, asyncio.TimeoutError): pass
    except (ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError) as e:
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception): await ws.send_json({'type':'error','message':str(e)})
    finally:
        peers.pop(ws,None)
        if task:
            task.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError,Exception): await task
        if room:
            for pid in owned: room.remove(pid)
            if not any(not p.bot for p in room.players.values()): rooms.pop(room.code,None)
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception): await ws.close()
``````

## backend/projectiles.py

``````python
"""Swept 3D throwable collision. All coordinates are x/y ground, z height."""
import math
from functools import lru_cache
from .hazards import train_pose


@lru_cache(maxsize=8)
def static_geometry(grid):
    seen=set(); boxes=[]; free=[]
    for y,row in enumerate(grid):
        for x,cell in enumerate(row):
            if cell=='0':
                free.append((x+.5,y+.5))
                continue
            if (x,y) in seen:continue
            height=3.8 if x in (0,len(row)-1) or y in (0,len(grid)-1) else 2.6
            def valid(xx,yy):
                return (0<=yy<len(grid) and 0<=xx<len(row) and grid[yy][xx]=='1'
                        and (xx,yy) not in seen and
                        (3.8 if xx in (0,len(row)-1) or yy in (0,len(grid)-1) else 2.6)==height)
            w=1
            while valid(x+w,y):w+=1
            d=1
            while all(valid(xx,y+d) for xx in range(x,x+w)):d+=1
            for yy in range(y,y+d):
                for xx in range(x,x+w):seen.add((xx,yy))
            boxes.append(dict(bounds=(x,y,0,x+w,y+d,height),kind='world'))
    return boxes,free


def world_geometry(room):
    boxes=list(static_geometry(tuple(room.arena['grid']))[0])
    boxes.extend(dict(bounds=tuple(b),kind='world') for b in room.arena.get('ballistic_solids',[]))
    w,h=room.arena['width'],room.arena['depth']
    for b in [(-100,-100,-100,0,h+100,100),(w,-100,-100,w+100,h+100,100),
              (0,-100,-100,w,0,100),(0,h,-100,w,h+100,100)]:
        boxes.append(dict(bounds=b,kind='boundary'))
    c=room.crane_state
    if c:boxes.append(dict(bounds=(c['x'],c['y'],c['lift'],c['x']+c['w'],c['y']+c['h'],c['lift']+2.6),kind='crane'))
    cfg=room.arena.get('train')
    if cfg:
        pose=train_pose(room.train_time,cfg)
        if pose['active']:
            for car in cfg['cars']:
                x=pose['x']+car['offset']
                boxes.append(dict(bounds=(x-car['length']/2,cfg['y']-car['width']/2,0,
                                          x+car['length']/2,cfg['y']+car['width']/2,4.8),kind='train'))
    clock=room.arena.get('clock')
    if clock:boxes.append(dict(bounds=(3,-.4,.78,13,.4,1.15),kind='clock',
                              angle=room.train_time*2*math.pi/clock['period'],pivot=(clock['x'],clock['y'])))
    return boxes


def sweep(start,end,boxes,radius):
    best=None;delta=[end[i]-start[i] for i in range(3)]
    if end[2]<=radius and delta[2]<0:
        t=max(0,min(1,(radius-start[2])/delta[2]))
        best=dict(t=t,normal=(0,0,1),point=[start[i]+delta[i]*t for i in range(3)],kind='floor')
    for box in boxes:
        bounds=box['bounds']
        if not box.get('angle') and any(max(start[i],end[i])+radius<bounds[i] or min(start[i],end[i])-radius>bounds[i+3] for i in range(3)):continue
        a=list(start);b=list(end);angle=box.get('angle',0);c,s=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
        if angle:
            px,py=box['pivot']
            a[:2]=[(a[0]-px)*c+(a[1]-py)*s,-(a[0]-px)*s+(a[1]-py)*c]
            b[:2]=[(b[0]-px)*c+(b[1]-py)*s,-(b[0]-px)*s+(b[1]-py)*c]
        lo=[v-radius for v in box['bounds'][:3]];hi=[v+radius for v in box['bounds'][3:]]
        d=[b[i]-a[i] for i in range(3)];enter,leave=-math.inf,math.inf;normal=[0,0,0]
        for i in range(3):
            if abs(d[i])<1e-12:
                if a[i]<lo[i] or a[i]>hi[i]:enter=math.inf;break
            else:
                t1,t2=(lo[i]-a[i])/d[i],(hi[i]-a[i])/d[i];n=-1 if d[i]>0 else 1
                if t1>t2:t1,t2=t2,t1
                if t1>enter:enter=t1;normal=[n if j==i else 0 for j in range(3)]
                leave=min(leave,t2)
        if enter>leave or leave<0 or enter>1:continue
        point=None
        if enter<0:
            choices=[(a[i]-lo[i],i,-1) for i in range(3)]+[(hi[i]-a[i],i,1) for i in range(3)]
            _,axis,n=min(choices);normal=[n if j==axis else 0 for j in range(3)]
            if sum(d[i]*normal[i] for i in range(3))>=-1e-10:continue
            point=list(a);point[axis]=lo[axis] if n<0 else hi[axis];enter=0
        if best and enter>=best['t']:continue
        if point is None:point=[a[i]+d[i]*enter for i in range(3)]
        if angle:
            point[:2]=[point[0]*c-point[1]*s+px,point[0]*s+point[1]*c+py]
            normal[:2]=[normal[0]*c-normal[1]*s,normal[0]*s+normal[1]*c]
        best=dict(t=max(0,enter),normal=normal,point=point,kind=box['kind'])
    return best


def can_stand(x,y,grid,boxes):
    if not all(0<=y+b<len(grid) and 0<=x+a<len(grid[0]) and grid[int(y+b)][int(x+a)]=='0'
               for a in (-.46,.46) for b in (-.46,.46)):return False
    return not any(b['kind'] in ('crane','train') and b['bounds'][2]<1.9 and
                   b['bounds'][0]-.46<x<b['bounds'][3]+.46 and b['bounds'][1]-.46<y<b['bounds'][4]+.46 for b in boxes)


def safe_floor(x,y,grid,boxes):
    if can_stand(x,y,grid,boxes):return x,y
    candidates=static_geometry(tuple(grid))[1]
    return min((p for p in candidates if can_stand(*p,grid,boxes)),
               key=lambda p:(p[0]-x)**2+(p[1]-y)**2,default=(x,y))


def advance(a,dt,kind,boxes,grid):
    radius=.08 if kind=='axe' else .12;gravity=12 if kind=='axe' else 9.8
    if kind=='axe' and a.get('ground'):
        a['x'],a['y']=safe_floor(a['x'],a['y'],grid,boxes);return
    slide=a.get('slide')
    if slide:
        dx,dy=slide[0]-a['x'],slide[1]-a['y'];dist=math.hypot(dx,dy);step=min(dist,5*dt)
        if dist>.001:a['x']+=dx/dist*step;a['y']+=dy/dist*step
        if dist<.05 or can_stand(a['x'],a['y'],grid,boxes):a.pop('slide',None)
        a['vx']=a['vy']=a['vz']=0
        return
    left=dt
    for _ in range(4):
        start=[a['x'],a['y'],a['z']]
        end=[a['x']+a['vx']*left,a['y']+a['vy']*left,a['z']+a['vz']*left-gravity*left*left/2]
        hit=sweep(start,end,boxes,radius)
        if not hit:
            a['x'],a['y'],a['z']=end;a['vz']-=gravity*left;return
        elapsed=left*hit['t'];a['vz']-=gravity*elapsed
        n=hit['normal'];a['x'],a['y'],a['z']=[hit['point'][i]+n[i]*.001 for i in range(3)]
        if kind=='axe':
            a['vx']=a['vy']=0
            if hit['kind']=='floor':
                a['z']=radius;a['ground']=True;a['vz']=0
                a['x'],a['y']=safe_floor(a['x'],a['y'],grid,boxes);return
            if n[2]>.6:
                a['slide']=list(safe_floor(a['x'],a['y'],grid,boxes));a['vz']=0;return
            a['vz']=min(0,a['vz'])
        else:
            v=[a['vx'],a['vy'],a['vz']];dot=sum(v[i]*n[i] for i in range(3))
            v=[(v[i]-1.4*min(0,dot)*n[i])*(.82 if n[2]>.6 and i<2 else 1) for i in range(3)]
            a['vx'],a['vy'],a['vz']=v
            if n[2]>.6 and abs(a['vz'])<.24:a['vz']=.24
        left*=1-hit['t']
        if left<1e-6:return
``````

``````javascript
/* One construction/detail standard for all five arenas. Original local assets. */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {Builder,mergeStatic} from './graphics.js';

import {ART,ART_REVISION} from './art-palettes.js';
export {ART,ART_REVISION};

function facade(b,p,x,z,w,d,h,side,index){
 const front=side===0?z+d/2:side===1?z-d/2:z;
 b.box(x,h/2,z,w,h,d,p.kind,p.wall);
 b.box(x,.38,z,w+.08,.76,d+.08,'concrete',p.trim);
 b.box(x,h-.14,z,w+.26,.3,d+.26,'stone',p.trim);
 b.box(x,h+.12,z,w+.10,.22,d+.10,'metal',p.roof);
 const faces=side<2?[{axis:'z',face:front,out:side===0?1:-1,length:w,center:x}]:[{axis:'x',face:side===2?x+w/2:x-w/2,out:side===2?1:-1,length:d,center:z}];
 for(const f of faces){
  const panel=(u,y,ww,hh,depth,kind,c,offset=0)=>f.axis==='z'?b.box(u,y,f.face+f.out*offset,ww,hh,depth,kind,c):b.box(f.face+f.out*offset,y,u,depth,hh,ww,kind,c);
  for(let y=2.25;y<h-1;y+=2.65){
   if(p.urban)panel(f.center,y-1.08,f.length+.04,.12,.14,'stone',p.trim,.05);
   for(let u=f.center-f.length/2+1.35;u<f.center+f.length/2-.8;u+=2.2){
    panel(u,y,1.30,1.67,.09,'stone',p.trim,.04);
    panel(u,y+.025,1.06,1.42,.035,'glass',p.glass,.098);
    panel(u,y,.055,1.42,.04,'metal',p.trim,.13);
    panel(u,y+.08,1.06,.05,.04,'metal',p.trim,.13);
    panel(u,y-.85,1.48,.10,.28,'stone',p.trim,.12);
    if(p.urban)panel(u,y+.93,1.44,.10,.22,'stone',p.trim,.10);
   }
  }
  panel(f.center,.95,1.28,1.9,.08,'metal',p.trim,.08);
  panel(f.center-.42,1.05,.05,.24,.06,'metal','#b8b4a0',.14);
  for(const u of [f.center-f.length/2+.18,f.center+f.length/2-.18]){
   panel(u,h/2,.18,h,.19,p.urban?'stone':'metal',p.trim,.10);
   if(p.urban)for(let y=.9;y<h-.3;y+=.46)panel(u,y,.25,.025,.22,'stone',p.wall,.13);
  }
  const pipe=f.center+f.length/2-.5;
  panel(pipe,h/2,.07,h,.09,'metal',p.roof,.18);
  for(let y=1;y<h;y+=2)panel(pipe,y,.18,.08,.13,'metal',p.trim,.20);
 }
 // Roof vents and parapets remain outside the playable collision grid.
 b.box(x,h+.35,z-d/2,w,.65,.16,'metal',p.roof);
 b.box(x,h+.35,z+d/2,w,.65,.16,'metal',p.roof);
 b.box(x-w/2,h+.35,z,.16,.65,d,'metal',p.roof);
 b.box(x+w/2,h+.35,z,.16,.65,d,'metal',p.roof);
 b.box(x-w*.22,h+.5,z,1.3,.8,1.1,'metal',p.trim);
 for(let i=0;i<5;i++)b.box(x-w*.22,h+.28+i*.11,z-.57,1.15,.025,.04,'metal',p.wall);
 b.tube(x+w*.25,h+1.05,z,.20,2.0,'metal',p.trim);
 if(p.urban){
  for(const zz of [z-d*.25,z+d*.25])b.box(x,h+.63,zz,w*.8,.17,.34,'stone',p.trim);
 }else{
  for(let xx=x-w/2+.4;xx<x+w/2;xx+=.65)b.box(xx,h+.27,z,.06,.08,d,'metal',p.trim);
 }
}

export function dressArenas(root,map,theme,surfaces){
 const id=theme.id,p=ART[id]||ART.railway,g=new THREE.Group();g.name='cohesive-world-details';root.add(g);
 const b=new Builder(g,surfaces),covers=root.userData.coverFootprints||[];let coverParts=0;
 for(const r of covers){
  const before=b.count,cargo=id==='freight'||id==='railway',trim=cargo?'#596c69':p.trim;
  // Feet, recessed panels and joints fit the existing 2.6 m solid volumes.
  if(cargo){
   for(const z of [r.y+.015,r.y+r.d-.015]){
    for(let x=r.x+.22;x<r.x+r.w-.12;x+=.32)b.box(x,1.31,z,.045,2.34,.045,'paint',trim);
    b.box(r.x+r.w/2,2.45,z,r.w-.14,.075,.075,'metal',trim);
    b.box(r.x+r.w/2,.19,z,r.w-.14,.075,.075,'metal',trim);
   }
   for(const x of [r.x+.015,r.x+r.w-.015])for(let z=r.y+.22;z<r.y+r.d-.12;z+=.32)b.box(x,1.31,z,.045,2.34,.045,'paint',trim);
   for(const x of [r.x+.13,r.x+r.w-.13])for(const z of [r.y+.13,r.y+r.d-.13]){
    b.box(x,2.52,z,.23,.16,.23,'metal','#51645e');
    b.box(x,.15,z,.23,.16,.23,'metal','#51645e');
   }
   // Both end doors have locking bars and hinge blocks.
   for(const x of [r.x+.05,r.x+r.w-.05])for(const z of [r.y+r.d*.27,r.y+r.d*.73]){
    b.tube(x,1.3,z,.025,2.12,'metal','#9ba99d');
    for(const y of [.45,1.25,2.15])b.box(x,y,z,.09,.08,.13,'metal','#788a80');
   }
  }else{
   for(const x of [r.x+.13,r.x+r.w-.13])for(const z of [r.y+.13,r.y+r.d-.13])b.box(x,1.3,z,.25,2.46,.25,id==='foundry'?'metal':'stone',trim);
   for(const z of [r.y+.025,r.y+r.d-.025]){
    b.box(r.x+r.w/2,1.3,z,Math.max(.25,r.w-.55),1.7,.07,id==='foundry'?'metal':'stone',id==='foundry'?'#64726b':p.wall);
    b.box(r.x+r.w/2,.43,z,Math.max(.25,r.w-.4),.10,.14,'stone',trim);
    b.box(r.x+r.w/2,2.18,z,Math.max(.25,r.w-.4),.10,.14,'stone',trim);
    if(id==='foundry')for(let x=r.x+.45;x<r.x+r.w-.2;x+=.55){b.box(x,2.2,z,.13,.07,.09,'metal','#d0ad65');b.box(x,.44,z,.13,.07,.09,'metal','#d0ad65');}
   }
   for(const y of [.2,2.5])b.box(r.x+r.w/2,y,r.y+r.d/2,r.w-.03,.12,r.d-.03,id==='foundry'?'metal':'stone',trim);
  }
  coverParts+=b.count-before;
 }
 // Eight finished facades on every map, using one window/trim/roof standard.
 // Harbor keeps its northern sea vista; railway keeps the end gates open.
 let facades=0;
 const sites=id==='freight'?[[8,43,1],[25,44,1],[43,43,1],[58,44,1],[-9,5,2],[-9,27,2],[69,5,3],[69,28,3]]:
  [[7,-9,0],[25,-10,0],[45,-9,0],[8,44,1],[28,45,1],[49,44,1],[-9,7,2],[69,28,3]];
 sites.forEach(([x,z,side],i)=>{const w=side<2?12:8,d=side<2?8:11,h=(p.urban?10:7)+(i%3)*2.65;facade(b,p,x,z,w,d,h,side,i);facades++;});
 // Close to the arena, details stay inside solid perimeter walls.
 for(let x=6;x<57;x+=10)for(const z of [.8,34.2]){
  b.box(x,.34,z,1.5,.6,.22,'metal',p.trim);
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++)b.box(x,.2+k*.1,z-.13,1.25,.025,.04,'metal',p.wall);
 }
 b.finish();
 root.userData.detailParts=(root.userData.detailParts||0)+g.userData.detailParts;
 root.userData.artDirection={revision:ART_REVISION,facades,covers:covers.length,coverParts,facadeStandard:'framed-glazing-roof-drainage',detailParts:g.userData.detailParts};
 return g;
}

export function finishLandmark(root,id,surfaces){
 if(!root)return;
 const g=new THREE.Group();g.name='landmark-finish';root.add(g);const p=ART[id],b=new Builder(g,surfaces);
 if(id==='glory'){
  for(const z of [9.56,14.44]){
   for(const y of [.35,1.31,1.59])b.box(20,y,z,3.72,.07,.09,'stone','#d8cdb4');
   b.box(20,.89,z,2.85,.48,.07,'stone','#938c76');
   for(let x=18.75;x<21.3;x+=.36)b.box(x,.89,z,.045,.35,.10,'metal','#b9b9a1');
  }
  for(const x of [18.28,21.72])for(const z of [9.94,14.06]){
   b.box(x,.9,z,.22,1.05,.22,'stone','#d3c9ae');
   b.box(x,.38,z,.31,.14,.31,'stone','#9c967e');
  }
  // A modest cyan inlay relates the monument to its shield ring.
  for(const z of [9.61,14.39])b.box(20,1.4,z,3.3,.035,.025,'glow','#70d7e2');
 }else if(id==='freight'||id==='foundry'){
  for(const x of [18.5,21.5])for(const z of [10,14]){
   b.box(x,.1,z,.55,.2,.5,'metal',p.trim);
   for(const xx of [-.16,.16])for(const zz of [-.14,.14])b.tube(x+xx,.22,z+zz,.035,.055,'metal','#a7ad98');
  }
 }else if(id==='plaza'){
  for(const x of [18.17,21.83])for(const z of [9.85,14.15]){
   b.box(x,.15,z,.3,.3,.3,'stone','#c5b998');
   for(let y=.4;y<2.4;y+=.26)b.box(x,y,z,.12,.018,.12,'stone','#8e8770');
  }
 }
 b.finish();root.userData.finishRevision=ART_REVISION;
}
``````

``````javascript
 foundry:{wall:'#87796b',trim:'#444a47',glass:'#3b4d51',floor:'#787569',kind:'brick',urban:false,roof:'#575b54',sky:['#777f86','#b0b4ae','#c6baa4'],sun:'#ffdbb8',fog:'#aaa596',exposure:1.02},
``````

## frontend/audio.js

``````javascript
/* Original synthesized positional game audio. No remote recordings or downloads. */
(()=>{
 class CheatSound{
  constructor(){this.context=null;this.volume=.25;this.listeners=[];this.buffers=new Map();this.voices=0;this.steps=new Map();this.ambientAt=0;}
  unlock(){try{this.context ||= new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();this.context.resume().catch(()=>{});}catch{}return this.context;}
  setListeners(list){this.listeners=list;}
  buffer(type,key){
   const c=this.context,id=type+':'+key;if(this.buffers.has(id))return this.buffers.get(id);
   const duration=type==='explosion'?.9:type==='reload'?.5:type==='ambient'?.6:type==='shot'?(key==='shotgun'?.65:key==='pistol'?.36:.43):.15;
   const b=c.createBuffer(1,Math.ceil(c.sampleRate*duration),c.sampleRate),d=b.getChannelData(0);let low=0;
   for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){
    const t=i/c.sampleRate,n=Math.random()*2-1;low=low*.92+n*.08;
    if(type==='hit')d[i]=Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*880)*Math.exp(-t*35)*.5;
    else if(type==='axe')d[i]=n*Math.sin(Math.min(1,t/.15)*Math.PI)*.4;
    else if(type==='pin'){d[i]=(n*Math.exp(-t*95)+Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*1800)*Math.exp(-t*65))*.45;}
    else if(type==='switch'||type==='grenade')d[i]=n*Math.exp(-t*65);
    else if(type==='reload')d[i]=n*(Math.exp(-t*70)+Math.exp(-Math.abs(t-.19)*100)*.7+Math.exp(-Math.abs(t-.39)*100)*.5);
    else if(type==='step')d[i]=low*Math.exp(-t*24)*2;
    else if(type==='hurt')d[i]=low*Math.exp(-t*14);
    else if(type==='ambient')d[i]=key==='freight'?low*.3:low*.4+Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*52)*.08;
    else if(type==='explosion')d[i]=(low*2+Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*(62-t*32))*.3)*Math.exp(-t*4.5);
    else{const weight=key==='shotgun'?1:key==='pistol'?.55:.75,crack=(n-low)*Math.exp(-t/(key==='pistol'?.004:.006)),body=low*5*weight*Math.exp(-t/(key==='shotgun'?.105:.055)),bolt=n*.16*Math.exp(-Math.abs(t-.038)*230),echo=low*weight*.55*Math.exp(-Math.abs(t-.095)*24);d[i]=Math.tanh((crack*.9+body+bolt+echo)*1.4)*Math.min(1,t/.0003);}
   }
   this.buffers.set(id,b);return b;
  }
  play(type,key='rifle',source=null){
   const c=this.context;if(!c||c.state!=='running'||this.volume<=0||this.voices>=28)return;
   let gain=1,pan=0;
   if(source&&this.listeners.length){const listener=this.listeners.reduce((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-source.x,a.y-source.y)<Math.hypot(b.x-source.x,b.y-source.y)?a:b);
    const distance=Math.hypot(source.x-listener.x,source.y-listener.y);gain=Math.max(0,1-distance/(type==='explosion'?65:45));if(gain<.015)return;
    pan=Math.sin(Math.atan2(source.y-listener.y,source.x-listener.x)-(listener.yaw||0))*.8;
   }
   const b=this.buffer(type,key),s=c.createBufferSource(),g=c.createGain(),f=c.createBiquadFilter(),p=c.createStereoPanner(),t=c.currentTime;
   s.buffer=b;f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.value=type==='shot'?(key==='pistol'?7200:key==='shotgun'?4400:6200):type==='step'?650:type==='ambient'?400:1800;p.pan.value=pan;
   const scale=type==='explosion'?.8:type==='shot'?.48:type==='ambient'?.1:type==='step'?.5:.18;
   g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(.0001,gain*this.volume*scale),t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+b.duration);
   s.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(p);p.connect(c.destination);this.voices++;s.onended=()=>{this.voices--;s.disconnect();f.disconnect();g.disconnect();p.disconnect();};s.start();
  }
  world(players,map,train,now){
   for(const p of players)if(p.hp>0&&Math.hypot(p.vx||0,p.vy||0)>1&&now>(this.steps.get(p.id)||0)){
    this.play('step','',p);this.steps.set(p.id,now+330*8/Math.max(4,Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy)));
   }
   for(const id of this.steps.keys())if(!players.some(p=>p.id===id))this.steps.delete(id);
   if(now>this.ambientAt&&['foundry','freight','railway'].includes(map)){this.play('ambient',map,train?.active?train:null);this.ambientAt=now+550;}
  }
 }
 window.CheatSound=CheatSound;
})();
``````

## frontend/axe-effects.js

``````javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';
export class AxeEffects{
 constructor(scene){
  this.tracks=new Map();this.transform=new THREE.Object3D();this.meshes={};const steel=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#aebbb5',metalness:.78,roughness:.29}),wood=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#69573e',roughness:.87});
  const shape=new THREE.Shape();shape.moveTo(-.12,.07);shape.lineTo(.04,.07);shape.lineTo(.16,.15);shape.lineTo(.20,.02);shape.lineTo(.16,-.13);shape.lineTo(.02,-.06);shape.lineTo(-.12,-.06);shape.closePath();
  const blade=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:.045,bevelEnabled:true,bevelSize:.006,bevelThickness:.004,bevelSegments:2,steps:1});blade.translate(0,.22,-.0225);
  const star=new THREE.Shape();for(let j=0;j<8;j++){const a=j*Math.PI/4,r=j%2?.035:.11;j?star.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r):star.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r);}star.closePath();
  const shapes={axe:[blade,steel],handle:[new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.018,.024,.62,12),wood],dagger:[new THREE.BoxGeometry(.035,.35,.012),steel],shuriken:[new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(star,{depth:.01,bevelEnabled:false}),steel]};
  for(const [key,[geo,mat]] of Object.entries(shapes)){const m=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo,mat,128);m.name='thrown-'+key;m.count=0;m.frustumCulled=false;scene.add(m);this.meshes[key]=m;}
 }
 update(axes,now,key){
  if(this.key!==key){this.key=key;this.tracks.clear();}const dt=Math.min(.12,Math.max(0,(now-(this.last||now))/1000));this.last=now;const alive=new Set(),counts={axe:0,handle:0,dagger:0,shuriken:0};
  for(const a of axes.slice(0,128)){alive.add(a.id);let t=this.tracks.get(a.id),target=new THREE.Vector3(a.x,a.z+(a.ground?.025:0),a.y);if(!t){t=target;this.tracks.set(a.id,t);}else t.lerp(target,1-Math.exp(-35*dt));const kind=a.weapon||'axe';this.transform.position.copy(t);this.transform.rotation.set(a.ground?Math.PI/2:now*.018,Math.atan2(a.vy,a.vx),a.ground?.3:0);this.transform.scale.setScalar(1);this.transform.updateMatrix();const keys=kind==='axe'?['axe','handle']:[kind];for(const k of keys){const mesh=this.meshes[k];if(mesh)mesh.setMatrixAt(counts[k]++,this.transform.matrix);}}
  for(const k of Object.keys(counts)){this.meshes[k].count=counts[k];this.meshes[k].instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;}for(const id of this.tracks.keys())if(!alive.has(id))this.tracks.delete(id);
 }
}
``````

``````javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';
// Bounded reusable pools: no geometry/material allocation per shot.
export class CombatEffects{
 constructor(scene){
  this.particles=[];this.particleCursor=0;this.damageSeen=new Map();
  this.drops=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.025,5,4),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:'#ffffff'}),192);this.drops.count=0;this.drops.frustumCulled=false;scene.add(this.drops);
  this.scene=scene;this.flashes=new Map();this.shells=[];this.cursor=0;
  this.geometry=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,7,5);
  this.fire=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:'#ffe4a0',transparent:true,opacity:.95,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,toneMapped:false});
  this.cases=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.009,.009,.045,7),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#c5a45e',metalness:.7,roughness:.35}),96);this.cases.count=0;this.cases.frustumCulled=false;scene.add(this.cases);this.transform=new THREE.Object3D();
 }
 update(actors,dt,now){
  for(const [id,a] of actors){
   const previous=this.damageSeen.get(id),blood=previous&&a.blood_seq>previous.blood,spark=previous&&a.shield_seq>previous.shield;
   if(blood||spark)for(let j=0;j<14;j++){this.particles[this.particleCursor]={p:a.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-.5)*.2,1.15+Math.random()*.35,0)),v:new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-.5)*3,Math.random()*2,(Math.random()-.5)*3),life:.6+Math.random()*.3,blood};this.particleCursor=(this.particleCursor+1)%192;}
   this.damageSeen.set(id,{blood:a.blood_seq,shield:a.shield_seq});
   let f=this.flashes.get(id);if(!f){const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(this.geometry,this.fire);mesh.visible=false;this.scene.add(mesh);f={mesh,shots:a.lastShots,until:0};this.flashes.set(id,f);}
   if(a.lastShots>f.shots&&['rifle','pistol','shotgun'].includes(a.shotWeapon||a.weapon)){
    f.until=now+85;
    const pos=a.gun.localToWorld(new THREE.Vector3(.08,.04,.15));
    const right=new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0).applyQuaternion(a.root.quaternion);
    for(let i=0;i<Math.min(3,a.lastShots-f.shots);i++){
     const shell={p:pos.clone(),v:right.clone().multiplyScalar(1.6+Math.random()).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,1.7+Math.random(),0)),life:2.4,spin:Math.random()*6,shotgun:a.weapon==='shotgun'};
     this.shells[this.cursor]=shell;this.cursor=(this.cursor+1)%96;
    }
   }
   f.shots=a.lastShots;f.mesh.position.copy(a.gun.localToWorld(new THREE.Vector3(0,.03,a.weapon==='pistol'?.27:.72)));
   a.gun.getWorldQuaternion(f.mesh.quaternion);f.mesh.scale.set(a.weapon==='shotgun'?.12:.075,.08,a.weapon==='shotgun'?.37:.22);f.mesh.visible=now<f.until&&a.hp>0;
  }
  for(const [id,f] of this.flashes)if(!actors.has(id)){this.scene.remove(f.mesh);this.flashes.delete(id);}
  for(const id of this.damageSeen.keys())if(!actors.has(id))this.damageSeen.delete(id);
  let n=0;for(const d of this.particles){if(!d||d.life<=0)continue;d.life-=dt;d.v.y-=7*dt;d.p.addScaledVector(d.v,dt);this.transform.position.copy(d.p);this.transform.rotation.set(0,0,0);this.transform.scale.set(1,Math.max(.3,d.life*2),1);this.transform.updateMatrix();this.drops.setMatrixAt(n,this.transform.matrix);this.drops.setColorAt(n++,new THREE.Color(d.blood?'#a61920':'#53ddff'));}this.drops.count=n;this.drops.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;if(this.drops.instanceColor)this.drops.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;
  let count=0;for(const c of this.shells){if(!c||c.life<=0)continue;c.life-=dt;c.v.y-=9.8*dt;c.p.addScaledVector(c.v,dt);if(c.p.y<.035){c.p.y=.035;c.v.y=Math.abs(c.v.y)*.3;c.v.x*=.6;c.v.z*=.6;}c.spin+=dt*12;
   this.transform.position.copy(c.p);this.transform.rotation.set(c.spin,c.spin*.6,c.spin*.3);this.transform.scale.set(c.shotgun?1.7:1,c.shotgun?1.4:1,c.shotgun?1.7:1);this.transform.updateMatrix();this.cases.setMatrixAt(count,this.transform.matrix);this.cases.setColorAt(count++,new THREE.Color(c.shotgun?'#b34b35':'#c5a45e'));
  }this.cases.count=count;this.cases.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;if(this.cases.instanceColor)this.cases.instanceColor.needsUpdate=true;
 }
 view(id,now){for(const [key,f] of this.flashes)f.mesh.visible=key!==id&&now<f.until;}
}
``````
